source.title: Hypnotic Dust — firsthand comment: 40 Spiritmend Belt disenchants

quote: make 40 Spiritmend Belt & disenchant them, which gave me 29 Hypnotic Dust
notes: First-person source distinguishes 27 dust obtained from ten Bastion of Twilight instance resets from 29 Hypnotic Dust generated by separately disenchanting 40 crafted Spiritmend Belts. ONLY the 40 belt casts and 29 dust units are recorded, not 56 combined units. No per-cast output hit count, individual stack sizes, zeros, skill, source build, item version or other materials; historical Cataclysm-era behavior must not be transferred unreviewed to modern ilvl variants.
